meta.title: HAZOP and LOPA of the VD-EJ unit
meta.scope: From the feed control valve FV-101 through the column T-101, reboiler E-101, overhead condenser E-102, reflux drum V-101 and vent condenser E-103 to the two-stage ejector set J-201/J-202 with E-201/E-202, the start-up hogger J-203, the hotwell V-201 and the condensate pumps P-201, including utilities (MP and LP steam, cooling and chilled water, N₂, instrument air, electrical power).
meta.objective: Identify the hazards and operability problems of the unit, judge their risk, and decide what must be added or changed. For the scenarios that need more than the existing safeguards, check the risk reduction by LOPA.
meta.assump: The unit is operated by trained staff at the design conditions (top 7.0 kPa a). MP steam, cooling water, nitrogen, instrument air and power are available at start-up. Instruments, trips and PSV-101 are tested on the plan in the maintenance procedure.
meta.protocol: Method: HAZOP to IEC 61882 with full recording. The team takes one node at a time, states its design intent, and applies the guide words to each parameter to find deviations. For each deviation it records the causes, the events that follow, the consequences without credit for safeguards, the existing safeguards, and the risk after safeguards (S × L). Rows above the tolerable level go to LOPA in the same worksheet: initiating-event frequency, enabling conditions and conditional modifiers, independent protection layers with their PFD, and the mitigated frequency compared with the tolerable event likelihood for the severity. Open points go to the Parking Lot; actions become recommendations with an owner and a due date.

N1.causes:
FV-101 fails closed
XV-101 closed by I-1
feed supply lost (off-plot)
FIC-101 transmitter reads high
N1.cons: Sump inventory falls (LIC-102 LO after about 17 min in the model); off-spec; reboiler keeps heating a shrinking inventory

N1.causes:
FIC-101 set point error
FV-101 positioner fault (opens)
FIC-101 transmitter reads low
N1.cons: Higher liquid and vapour load: flooding (PDI-105), acrylic acid in the distillate, sump level rises

N1.causes:
FIC-101 in MAN at low output
feed strainer partly blocked
N1.cons: Turndown: poor wetting of the packing, off-spec products
Feed flashes at 7 kPa a: extra vapour to E-102 and the ejectors, top pressure rises, entrainment

N1.dev: Column top pressure above 7.0 kPa a (loss of vacuum)
N1.causes:
Ejector capacity lost (motive steam, cooling water, see N5–N8)
air in-leakage
PV-201 opens too far
E-102 condensing capacity lost
N1.cons: Boiling points rise with the pressure: the bottoms reach 95 °C at a top pressure of 14.2 kPa a and 100 °C at 19.9 kPa a; acrylic acid polymerises (exothermic, can run away), plugs packing, reboiler and lines; off-spec

N1.causes:
N2 supply lost (no bleed)
PT-101 reads high
PIC-101 in MAN with PV-201 closed
N1.cons: Lower boiling points, larger vapour volume: flooding and loss of product to the vent; no mechanical concern (T-101 rated for full vacuum)

N1.dev: Positive pressure instead of vacuum (N2 overpressure)
N1.causes:
HV-202 left open with XV-201 shut
PV-201 open with the ejectors stopped
N2 header at 5 bar g
N1.cons: Column pressurised above its 3.5 bar g design: flange leaks or rupture, release of hot acetic and acrylic acid (flammable, corrosive)

N1.dev: Air (oxygen) in the column and overhead
N1.causes:
In-leakage at flanges, sight glasses and seals
a drain or vent opened under vacuum
XV-203 passing
N1.cons: More non-condensable load: pressure rises (see N1.5); oxygen with hot acetic and acrylic acid vapour can form a flammable mixture in the column top, E-103, the vacuum line and the ejectors; ignition by static or pyrophoric and polymer deposits → internal deflagration

N1.dev: Feed off design composition (more acetic acid or water)
N1.cons: More overhead vapour and vent load; water lowers the dew point in E-103; off-spec

sg.text: TSHH-104 100 °C → I-1 closes XV-101 and XV-102
PSHH-102 30 kPa a (I-1, armed in RUN)
PSV-101 set 3.5 bar g to flare
PSHH-102 30 kPa a (I-1, in RUN only)
check valves on the N2 injections (VD-PID-201 note 7)
PIC-101 (PV-201 closes to absorb a leak)
ejectors sized for 18.54 kg/h against 10 kg/h actual leak

recs.text: Cut the reboiler heat before the bottoms reach 100 °C on a loss of vacuum: add a column-pressure initiator to I-1 below the pressure at which TI-104 reaches 95 °C (top 14.2 kPa a), or re-set TSHH-104, setting and process safety time to be confirmed in the SRS of SIF tab. In every dynamic run TSHH-104 was the first out; PSHH-102 (30 kPa a) never acted first.
Define the polymerisation-inhibitor system (inhibitor, dosing points to feed and reflux, minimum concentration, oxygen need of phenolic inhibitors) and show it on VD-PID-101.
Simulator training on the dynamic-check scenarios (loss of CW, loss of motive steam, air ingress, vacuum break) for every shift.

Verify the PSV-101 relief case for N2 at 5 bar g through HV-202 / PV-201 with the ejectors stopped (TBC on VD-PID-101 note 9) and its seat tightness against back-flow from the flare under vacuum (consider a rupture disc with tell-tale upstream).

Write the vacuum-break and shutdown procedure: cool to TI-104 < 80 °C under vacuum, break with N2 only through HV-202, never with air; close HV-202 at ≥ 95 kPa a; car-seal closed all vents and drains on vacuum equipment.
Leak (rate-of-rise or blank-off) test before every start-up and after maintenance, acceptance within the HEI allowance of 18.54 kg/h; trend the PV-201 opening as a leak indicator.
Add an oxygen analyser on the vent gas (E-103 outlet / J-201 suction) with a high alarm, set from the limiting oxygen concentration of acetic and acrylic acid (TBC).
